name: PocketGuard
description: PocketGuard is a personal budgeting app that brings linked accounts, spending, bills, goals, debt payoff, and a spendable-money view into one place. People use it to understand cash flow, organize recurring costs, and plan day-to-day household finances.
agentUseSummary: PocketGuard does not publish a supported third-party account API, so Relay does not request banking credentials, automate its private clients, or expose agent actions.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is offered without a provider-supported third-party API contract.

providerSetup.blocker: PocketGuard's official website and help center do not publish a developer application, delegated authorization flow, account API, or webhook contract for third-party access.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if PocketGuard publishes an official third-party developer program and documented authorization and account-data APIs.

evidence.supports: PocketGuard presents a consumer budgeting product for linked accounts, spending, bills, goals, and financial planning, with no developer integration entry point.
PocketGuard's official support surface documents product use and account-linking features but does not provide a third-party API, authorization, scopes, or developer registration contract.
PocketGuard describes receiving information from other services through their APIs; it does not grant third parties an API for accessing a PocketGuard user's data.
